info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Payment Details Retrieval API
info.description: The Payment Details Retrieval API provides access to detailed information about domestic scheduled payments within the open banking framework. This service allows authorized users to retrieve specific payment details using a unique payment identifier. Retail banks and fintech applications typically consume this API to track payment statuses or resolve customer inquiries. It serves as a vital resource for enhancing user experience and ensuring transparency in transaction management.

get.summary: Retrieve payment details for a scheduled domestic payment.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific scheduled domestic payment identified by its unique payment ID. It provides comprehensive information about the payment, including its status, amount, and processing information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the details of a scheduled payment with the ID PAY-300045. The request expects specific parameters to be provided in JSON format in order to successfully fetch the relevant payment details.
